about: Hand readings for the SRD where its words do not say a rule plainly. The book compiler (director/tools/compile-book.mjs) applies these before it reads the book; a field set to null stays empty. 'how' says when a spell's damage happens: attack, save and auto are dealt by the Engine when the spell is cast; the rest are left to the Director: mishap (only when the spell goes wrong), retort (to a creature that strikes the caster), later (on later turns), trap (when the warding is set off), option (one of the spell's choices), incidental (a side effect, such as burning webs).
